ev.q: Four unrelated cases of histoplasmosis were identified during 2012–2013
Three patients reported no recent travel outside of Montana
Three of four patients with diagnosed histoplasmosis reported no recent travel
No epidemiologic links among the cases were identified.

methods_quotes.q: Each patient's medical records were reviewed, and their exposure and travel histories were obtained.
